competitiveTarget: Lead with live local market data, Amboqia stat numerals, interactive neighborhood map, and editorial editorial editorial broker presence. Beat Cascade Hasson / Stellar Realty / Zillow Central Oregon by showing the real numbers first and keeping every stat traceable to the Supabase DAL.
note: Homepage rebuilt to v3 design language (2026-06-10 Experience Rollout family 2). All v3 components imported by app/page.tsx. SiteHeader/SiteFooter render from app/layout.tsx and are intentionally omitted from requiredComponents. The gate checks the route file's imports.
